FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Creative Edge Design Studio, our core operations focus on providing high-quality graphic design and commercial art services, primarily in a digital-only environment. Our team, consisting of fewer than 10 talented individuals, specializes in branding, logo design, and web graphics, ensuring all deliverables are crafted with precision and creativity to meet client specifications. We maintain a secure workflow by utilizing up-to-date, licensed software and implementing robust cybersecurity protocols. Our consultations and feedback sessions are conducted virtually to align with our operational structure and enhance client collaboration. We prioritize client data integrity through regular backups and have established clear contracts outlining project timelines and payment terms, all while steering clear of complex media production or large-scale physical installations that may expose us to heightened risk.

Our business specializes in graphic design and commercial art, frequently creating advertising materials and multimedia content for various clients, including video productions and online campaigns.
